concrete.feature:
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types:
      - labeled
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'PR number to verify (must be merged)'
        required: true
        type: string
      mode:
        description: 'Verification mode'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - evaluate
          - checkbox
          - compare
        default: 'evaluate'
      model:
        description: >-
          Model override for evaluation. Leave empty to use slot 1.
          For stricter evaluation, use compare mode with different providers.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      model2:
        description: >-
          Second model for compare mode (cross-provider verification).
          Leave empty to use slot 2.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      evidence_profile:
        description: 'Bounded input limits; expanded retries documented input truncation only'
        required: false
        type: choice
        options: [standard, expanded]
        default: 'standard'
      provider:
        description: 'LLM provider override (auto uses slot order)'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - auto
          - github-models
          - openai
          - anthropic
        default: 'auto'

name: Stop when verifier is skipped
        if: steps.context.outputs.should_run != 'true'
        run: |

name: Prepare verifier prompt
        if: steps.context.outputs.should_run == 'true'
        id: prepare
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Use prompt from Workflows repo
          base_prompt=".workflows-lib/.github/codex/prompts/verifier_acceptance_check.md"
          context_file="${{ steps.context.outputs.context_path }}"
          combined="verifier-prompt.md"

          if [ ! -f "$base_prompt" ]; then
            echo "::error::Base prompt file missing: $base_prompt"
            exit 1
          fi

            exit 1
          fi

          {
            cat "$base_prompt"
            printf '\n\n---\n\n'
            cat "$context_file"
          } > "$combined"
          echo "prompt_file=$combined" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

name: Run verifier (checkbox mode)
        id: codex
        if: steps.context.outputs.should_run == 'true' && inputs.mode != 'evaluate' && inputs.evidence_profile != 'expanded'
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          CODEX_HOME: ${{ runner.temp }}/.codex-verifier
          CODEX_MODEL_CANDIDATES: ${{ steps.codex_model.outputs.candidates }}
          CODEX_MODEL_SELECTION_REASON: ${{ steps.codex_model.outputs.selection_reason }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PROMPT_FILE="${{ steps.prepare.outputs.prompt_file }}"
          if [ -z "${CODEX_CLI:-}" ] || [ ! -x "${CODEX_CLI}" ]; then
            echo "::error::CODEX_CLI unset/not executable" \
              "(expected pinned node_modules/.bin/codex from Install Codex CLI)"
            exit 1
          fi

          selected_model=""
          selected_reason="${CODEX_MODEL_SELECTION_REASON:-input}"
          codex_exit_code=1
          attempt=0
          IFS=' ' read -r -a codex_models <<< "${CODEX_MODEL_CANDIDATES:-}"
          model_count="${#codex_models[@]}"

          for codex_model in "${codex_models[@]}"; do
            attempt=$((attempt + 1))
            rm -f codex-output.md codex-stdout.log codex-stderr.log
            echo "Running Codex verifier with model '${codex_model}' (${attempt}/${model_count})..."

            set +e
            # Invoke the pinned local binary exported by Install Codex CLI (not bare PATH `codex`).
            "$CODEX_CLI" exec \
              --sandbox read-only \
              --skip-git-repo-check \
              --model "$codex_model" \
              -c 'model_reasoning_effort="medium"' \
              --output-last-message codex-output.md \
              "$(cat "$PROMPT_FILE")" \
              > codex-stdout.log 2> codex-stderr.log
            codex_exit_code=$?
            set -euo pipefail

            if [ -s codex-stdout.log ]; then
              echo "=== Codex stdout (${codex_model}) ==="
              cat codex-stdout.log
            fi
            if [ -s codex-stderr.log ]; then
              echo "=== Codex stderr (${codex_model}) ===" >&2
              cat codex-stderr.log >&2
            fi

            selected_model="$codex_model"
            if [ "$codex_exit_code" -eq 0 ]; then
              if [ "$attempt" -gt 1 ]; then
                selected_reason="runtime-fallback-model-unavailable"
              fi
              break
            fi

            unsupported_model_pattern="$(
              printf '%s' \
                'model.*(not supported|not available|unsupported|' \
                'unavailable)|not compatible'
            )"
            if [ "$attempt" -lt "$model_count" ] &&
              grep -Eiq "$unsupported_model_pattern" \
                codex-stdout.log codex-stderr.log; then
              echo "::warning::Codex model '${codex_model}' was unavailable; " \
                "trying the next verifier model."
              selected_reason="runtime-fallback-model-unavailable"
              continue
            fi

            break
          done

          if [ -z "$selected_model" ]; then
            selected_model="${{ steps.codex_model.outputs.model }}"
          fi

          {
            echo "model=$selected_model"
            echo "selection_reason=$selected_reason"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          echo "Codex verifier completed (exit code: ${codex_exit_code})"
          echo "Codex verifier model: ${selected_model}"
          echo "Codex verifier model selection reason: ${selected_reason}"
          if [ -f codex-output.md ]; then
            echo "=== Verifier Output ==="
            cat codex-output.md
          fi
          exit "${codex_exit_code}"

name: Run LLM evaluation
        id: llm_evaluate
        if: >-
          ${{
            steps.context.outputs.should_run == 'true' &&
            inputs.mode == 'evaluate' &&
            steps.openai_key.outputs.available == 'true'
          }}
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          CLAUDE_API_STRANSKE: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_STRANSKE }}
          LANGSMITH_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.LANGSMITH_API_KEY }}
          PYTHONPATH: .workflows-lib
          CHAIN_DEPTH: ${{ steps.context.outputs.chain_depth || '0' }}
          VERIFIER_CONTEXT_PATH: ${{ steps.context.outputs.context_path }}
          VERIFIER_DIFF_PATH: ${{ steps.context.outputs.diff_path }}
          VERIFIER_MODEL: ${{ inputs.model }}
          VERIFIER_PROVIDER: ${{ inputs.provider }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          context_file="$VERIFIER_CONTEXT_PATH"
          diff_file="$VERIFIER_DIFF_PATH"
          model="$VERIFIER_MODEL"
          provider="$VERIFIER_PROVIDER"
          if [ "$provider" = "auto" ]; then
            provider=""
          fi

          # Build args array
          args=(--context-file "$context_file" --json)
          if [ -n "$diff_file" ] && [ -f "$diff_file" ]; then
            args+=(--diff-file "$diff_file")
          fi
          if [ -n "$model" ]; then
            args+=(--model "$model")
          fi
          if [ -n "$provider" ] && [ "$provider" != "github-models" ]; then
            args+=(--provider "$provider")
          fi
          agent_label="${{ steps.agent.outputs.agent_label || '' }}"
          from_label="${{ steps.agent.outputs.from_label || '' }}"
          args+=(--create-issue)
          if [ -n "$agent_label" ]; then
            args+=(--issue-label "$agent_label")
          fi
          if [ -n "$from_label" ]; then
            args+=(--issue-label "$from_label")
          fi
          args+=(--issue-label verify:evaluate)

          # Run evaluator (stderr to separate file to avoid corrupting JSON)
          python .workflows-lib/scripts/langchain/pr_verifier.py "${args[@]}" \
            > evaluation.json 2> evaluation-stderr.log || true

          # Parse result
          if [ -f evaluation.json ]; then
          python3 - <<'PY' > evaluation-outputs.env 2>/dev/null || true
          import json

          try:
            with open('evaluation.json', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
              data = json.load(handle)
          except Exception:
            data = {}

          print(f"verdict={data.get('verdict', 'CONCERNS')}")
          print(f"trace_id={data.get('langsmith_trace_id', '')}")
          print(f"trace_url={data.get('langsmith_trace_url', '')}")
          PY

            if [ -s evaluation-outputs.env ]; then
              cat evaluation-outputs.env >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              verdict="$(grep '^verdict=' evaluation-outputs.env | cut -d= -f2- || true)"
              trace_id="$(grep '^trace_id=' evaluation-outputs.env | cut -d= -f2- || true)"
              trace_url="$(grep '^trace_url=' evaluation-outputs.env | cut -d= -f2- || true)"
            else
              verdict="CONCERNS"
              trace_id=""
              trace_url=""
            fi

            echo "::debug::Evaluation verdict: $verdict"
            if [ -n "$trace_id" ]; then
              echo "::debug::LangSmith trace id: $trace_id"
            fi

            # Log trace URL for easy access from workflow logs
            if [ -n "$trace_url" ]; then
              echo "::notice title=LangSmith Trace::View trace: $trace_url"
            fi

            # Format output for comment
            python3 - <<'PYFORMAT'
          import json
          import sys

          try:
              with open('evaluation.json') as f:
                  data = json.load(f)

              lines = ["## LLM Evaluation Report", ""]
              lines.append(f"**Verdict:** {data.get('verdict', 'UNKNOWN')}")
              lines.append("")

              if data.get('summary'):
                  lines.append(f"**Summary:** {data['summary']}")
                  lines.append("")

              scores = data.get('scores')
              if scores:
                  lines.append("### Scores")
                  lines.append("| Criterion | Score |")
                  lines.append("|-----------|-------|")
                  for key in ['correctness', 'completeness', 'quality', 'testing', 'risks']:
                      score = scores.get(key, 'N/A')
                      lines.append(f"| {key.capitalize()} | {score}/10 |")
                  lines.append("")

              concerns = data.get('concerns', [])
              if concerns:
                  lines.append("### Concerns")
                  for c in concerns:
                      if c:
                          lines.append(f"- {c}")
                  lines.append("")

              # Add LangSmith trace link if available
              trace_url = data.get('langsmith_trace_url')
              if trace_url:
                  lines.append("### 🔍 LangSmith Trace")
                  lines.append(f"[View detailed evaluation trace]({trace_url})")
                  lines.append("")

              if data.get('error'):
                  lines.append(f"**Note:** {data['error']}")

              with open('evaluation-comment.md', 'w') as f:
                  f.write('\n'.join(lines))
          except Exception as e:
              with open('evaluation-comment.md', 'w') as f:
                  f.write(f"## LLM Evaluation\n\nEvaluation encountered an error: {e}")
          PYFORMAT

            cat evaluation-comment.md
          else
            echo "verdict=CONCERNS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            printf "%s\n" \
              "## LLM Evaluation" \
              "" \
              "Evaluation could not run (missing output)." \
              > evaluation-comment.md
          fi

name: Set unified verdict
        id: unified_verdict
        if: steps.context.outputs.should_run == 'true'
        env:
          VERIFIER_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
        run: |
          # Combine verdicts from all modes
          checkbox_verdict="${{ steps.verdict.outputs.verdict }}"
          llm_verdict="${{ steps.llm_evaluate.outputs.verdict }}"
          compare_verdict="${{ steps.llm_compare.outputs.verdict }}"

          if [ "$VERIFIER_MODE" = "evaluate" ]; then
            final_verdict="${llm_verdict:-unknown}"
          elif [ "$VERIFIER_MODE" = "compare" ]; then
            final_verdict="${compare_verdict:-unknown}"
          else
            final_verdict="${checkbox_verdict:-unknown}"
          fi

          # CI-failure hard gate (issue #2271): a CI workflow concluding
          # `failure` on the merge commit disqualifies a PASS verdict. Floor
          # the unified verdict at CONCERNS so a merge that breaks main can
          # never verify PASS, regardless of the LLM's acceptance review.
          ci_failed="${{ steps.context.outputs.ci_failed }}"
          lc_verdict="$(printf '%s' "$final_verdict" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          if [ "$ci_failed" = "true" ] && {
            [ "$lc_verdict" = "pass" ] || [ "$lc_verdict" = "passed" ];
          }; then
            echo "::warning::CI concluded failure on the merge commit; " \
              "overriding ${final_verdict} verdict to CONCERNS (issue #2271)."
            final_verdict="concerns"
          fi

          echo "verdict=$final_verdict" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Final verdict: $final_verdict"

      # DISABLED: Automatic follow-up issue creation
      # Use verify:create-issue label on PRs with CONCERNS to manually create follow-up issues

          if [ "$ci_failed" = "true" ] && {
            [ "$lc_verdict" = "pass" ] || [ "$lc_verdict" = "passed" ];
          }; then
            echo "::warning::CI concluded failure on the merge commit; " \
              "overriding ${final_verdict} verdict to CONCERNS (issue #2271)."
            final_verdict="concerns"
          fi

          echo "verdict=$final_verdict" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Final verdict: $final_verdict"
